PhotoSlop · Live

PhotoSlop: photo editor

Photoshop, rebuilt for the browser.

Open now

Watch the PhotoSlop tutorial: a free photo editor in the browser
On YouTube, about two minutes.

PhotoSlop has these main features: Layers, masks & 17 blend modes; Real PSD open & save. It opens Any image, Photoshop (PSD), OpenRaster.

What you can do with PhotoSlop

  • Open and view PSD files online
  • Remove blemishes, spots and dust from a photo
  • Deep fry a picture for a meme
  • A free Photoshop alternative in your browser
